title: Elarrathin Residence Backdoor Key
summary: Opens the back door at Jaheira’s Elarrathin Residence.

fields.Use: Unlock the back door at X: −230, Y: −53. The door can also be picked with DC 15 Sleight of Hand.
fields.Acquisition: In the cupboard inside the house near the back door.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay, acquisition, and pinned source evidence.
